name: nutrient_starvation_control
title: Nutrient-starvation negative control
claim: With zero glucose the dynamic-FBA cell does not grow: biomass stays flat within noise. The growth seen in every other study is therefore carbon-driven, not a numerical artifact — this negative control passes by rejecting growth.

purpose.question: With no carbon source, does the dynamic-FBA model correctly fail to grow — the falsification control that the growth signal is real, not an artifact?
purpose.mechanism: New biology-forward study (discovery engine): a new configuration/analysis of a real spatio-flux composite.
purpose.expected_outcome: The quantitative behavior tests pass, confirming the stated emergent/metabolic claim.

question: With no carbon source, does the dynamic-FBA model correctly fail to grow — the falsification control that the growth signal is real, not an artifact?

behavior_tests.name: NUTRIENT-STARVATION-NO-GROWTH
behavior_tests.description: with zero glucose, biomass stays flat (no growth) within tolerance.

findings.statement: With no carbon source the cell does not grow — biomass is flat within noise. This adversarial control passes by REJECTING growth, establishing that the biomass increases throughout the investigation are carbon-driven biology, not a solver artifact.

resolved: Growth requires a carbon source; with none, the model correctly produces no biomass.
remaining: Other falsification controls (e.g. zero-oxygen, blocked uptake) could further bound the growth claim.

followup_study_proposals.motivation: A carbon-present-but-uptake-blocked control would separate 'no substrate' from 'no uptake capacity' as causes of no growth.
followup_study_proposals.candidate: ecoli_core_dfba with a clamped/knocked-out glucose exchange

falsifiability: If biomass grew with zero glucose, this control would fail — and the carbon-driven interpretation of growth in every other study would be undermined.
limitations: Controls only the carbon source; other potential growth drivers (e.g. maintenance energy) are not separately clamped.

alternative_hypotheses.hypothesis: The absence of growth is a solver failure rather than biology.
alternative_hypotheses.excluded_by: The identical model with glucose present grows normally (glucose_limitation_yield), so the solver is live; only the carbon source is removed here.
